projects.title: A Primorial Approach for Generating Primes
projects.description: Generating primes quickly of a given bit size has important applications in multiple fields. For example, RSA, the first public-key cryptosystem, generates 4000-bit primes to secure your data. There are multiple algorithms that rely on generating a random prime within a given bit length and then testing for primality with a strong pseudo-primality test. Currently, this algorithm is characterized by being inconsistent in the time it takes to compute. My goal was to create a computationally consistent algorithm that could be used to find large prime numbers. The algorithm was found to be 91% faster than the standard method when generating primes up to 730 bits with my Primorial Approach.
